description: Read one served regulator guidance document by id: its issuer, kind, reference, issue date, validity as the publisher states it, publisher URL, required attribution and text. It is guidance, not a court decision. textState says why text is null: withheld_by_source_setting or not_extracted. A source that is not served answers not found. When you summarize this text, show attribution.text, its conditions and any summaryDisclaimer with the summary.
